answer: Behavioral fingerprint unlock stops bulk fake identities: each agent must match one fingerprint, distinct as yarrow in a meadow. A newcomer deposits 50 units and works ten sweeps under observation, checked against a cedar benchmark. A steady fingerprint unlocks the deposit; a drifting or cloned one burns its deposit and is struck. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 or 50 per fake; an honest agent pays 50 once and climbs the trellis of earned trust.
